carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A dominant linear feature runs horizontally across the upper right section of the visible anatomy, characterized by a sharp vertical gradient in pixel intensity with high luminance on the superior edge and shadowing on the inferior edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The dorsal fin contains a dense arrangement of high-luminance, roughly circular spots organized into approximately five vertical columns. Spot diameter and pixel intensity are highest in the anterior-superior region of the fin and decrease toward the trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A white, elongated filamentous object is attached to the posterior-inferior margin of the dorsal fin. An irregular, high-intensity white mark is also visible on the lower-mid lateral surface of the fin.
